name: EAGLE-2 acceptance length and speedup on Vicuna-13B (temperature=1)
methodology: temperature=1, 6 tasks. Average acceptance length τ = 4.26 tokens per draft-verify cycle. Speedup 3.65x mean across tasks.
notes: At temperature=1 (stochastic sampling), acceptance rates are lower than at temperature=0 but EAGLE-2 still achieves 3.65x speedup. The gap between temperature=0 (4.04x) and temperature=1 (3.65x) shows that stochastic sampling reduces acceptance rate. Baseline is vanilla autoregressive decoding.
